early.rule: 0 < ask <= .45; fair >= .75; edge >= .08 (redundant); 120 <= seconds_left <= 600; abs(BTC-target) >= 25; no persistence/strengthening/target-side gate
early.verification: protected_frame, qualify and native_frame AST-identical to pinned source; boundary grid; no rescoring

final.rule: fair >= .90; seconds_left <=480; gap >=75 if left>360 else >=50; distance/range5 >=1; preferred side agrees with BTC target side; existing BRTI abs gap >11 and side/freshness preserved

scalp.rule: Both sides; same-contract causal BTC30 >=15 aligned to side; >=120s at new entry; no price band, confirmation gate, cooldown or count cap; +.05 arm / .04 giveback from running executable BID peak; immutable original ASK; strictly later BID; serial after EXIT or informational ENDED_UNARMED; armed/no-exit blocks same-contract lane beyond horizon
scalp.metrics_are: Movement/lifecycle metrics, not FINAL settlement accuracy
